# IT Kamianets 3D Engine

> Unity packages, engine-independent JSON schemas, and constructors (one per camera style) for building 3D games. Games such as Temnorid Arena, Craft, Dungeons and Master are built from them.

## Packages

- [packages.md](https://3d.itkamianets.com/packages.md): every public package (schemas, core, game kit, specific, constructor parts) with its purpose, usage, dependencies, install order and git URL. Read this to choose packages for a new constructor or game.

## Docs

- [Start a game](https://3d.itkamianets.com/docs/start-a-game): clone a constructor starter repository (an empty Unity project) under your game name, add the engine packages, work with an AI agent, send engine changes back as pull requests.
- [Installation](https://3d.itkamianets.com/docs/installation): Unity requirements, starter repositories, installing packages by git URL.
- [Architecture](https://3d.itkamianets.com/docs/architecture): layers, the five schemas, character and camera, multiplayer, the game kit.
- [Examples](https://3d.itkamianets.com/docs/examples): a first-person game from a starter repository, a multiplayer match, a room scan, the games built on the engine.

## Source

- [GitHub organization](https://github.com/IT-Kamianets): one repository per package, constructor part and game.
